workflow_delta.title: Partial return from an order while keeping one item
workflow_delta.task_signature: Customer wants to return some items from a single order (keep at least one item) and receive a refund to the original payment method.
workflow: Authenticate the customer using approved identifiers (e.g., email or name plus ZIP).
Collect or locate the order: request the order number and, if lookup.
Present the order’s itemized list and ask the customer to explicitly confirm.
Confirm refund destination (original payment method vs. alternative) and summarize the return.
Submit the return request and then provide next-step logistics (how to return).

workflow_delta.title: Set up an exchange for a delivered item to a different configuration
workflow_delta.task_signature: Customer received an item and wants to exchange it for a different variant/configuration; agent authenticates, identifies the delivered order and item, finds an in-stock.
workflow: Authenticate the customer using available identifiers (e.g., email or name plus ZIP).
Locate the relevant delivered order and the specific item to exchange; confirm.
Look up product variants and inventory; identify an in-stock replacement that matches.
Calculate the price difference between original and replacement item and confirm the.
Submit the exchange request by linking the original item and replacement variant.
